notes.title: Patch v1.3
notes.content:
Inukari - Fateful detour is out now!

To celebrate and for all your dedication to Inukari I made this big update.
With that I bring you the new animation behind fateful detour to the origin title Chase of deception.
Cause its so much more fun to watch her in that way and to reward your dedication its here for free.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38835494/608662ecf77c56f7552b63b8ced53e6a245c89db.gif[/img]

[list]
[h3]More Features and bugfixes[/h3]
[*] Also the improved melee and shuriken attack animation and script.
[*] With that the stucking recharge bug is no more!
[*] Enemies tweaks like attackranges and so on.
[*] Overwork framerate
[*] Tweaks on maps. Like the hills waterfalls.
[*] minor Bosstweaks
[/list]

Hope this update inspires you to take a look again on Inukari. 
It's a passion project for myself and always a big fun.


Thanks for your feedback, your time and everything.

Kai Kieschnick <3

notes.title: Inukari - Chase of Deception 1.2
notes.content:
Hey lil foxes out there,
thank you so much for all the feedback which I've received over the last months.
After the great launch on consoles I'm back with a patch for the steam version. I also planned for switch and Xbox as fast as we can. Nintendo patch policy always took some time. So stay tuned for that. 
Also RedDeerGames need a big time to watch over what I've done and implement it to their port.
But I talked with them yesterday and we both will happy to give all of you the best result we can make :3

[h1]Features[/h1]

[h2]Improved Boss Fights[/h2]

There some skills and movements some of you found awkward or hard to read.
So I try to make a change here.

• Better dodge by Boss Fulurs Air attack.
Means they might fallen down faster but the time for dodging or Jump over feels more natural.

• Improved version of snow leopard Schamar
There is a new version of her special attack while she is charging. You can now better see the lightbolts and dodge them. Also reduce its flickering and lightning. To have a clearer view.

• Because of this I make her a bit faster and her attack timer changes from 0,8 to 0,5. 
What makes her hunt you more merciless to balance her special attack.


Fixes
• Add more space on that good damn waterfall section you can land on. Its now from 1,1 to 1,3. So you have a bit more control on the tree stumps. But it stays a challenge. 

A concluding word:
Its an awesome time for my after finding a great partner in RedDeerGames. As an indie dev. I always be like. NO I wanna do it all on my own. But they truly help me with many things. Mostly to make Inukari better known. There so many LP's out there right now. And yes there a some imperfection. No doubt. But I'm very Proud about my lil game and truly happy to get feedback and critique from all of you.
This all could lead us to a better game and maybe to a Inukari2 which will learn about all of this.

Just saying :3
Kai Kieschnick
Einzelartig Games

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38835494/b15a503731b4377e8d52f3825cef4e5aaca89184.png[/img]

notes.title: Inukari - Chase of Deception 1.1
notes.content:
Hey folks,
thank you so much for all the feedback which I've received in the last few months.
I've put a lot of effort and poured all my heart out in [b]Inukari[/b] and will always work on it and my other projects for improvements.

Even tho I don't want to twist myself and my visions of this game.
[b]Inukari[/b] is and will be a hard / difficult game. 
I don't even want to be nostalgic with it. It just fits. But I have some features for you to facilitate your gaming experience - for the ones who'd like to have it a little easier.
 
[h1]Features[/h1]

[h2]Easy mode[/h2]
is now inserted, which will heal you up, if you collect a heart.
 
[h2]Speedrun mode has been elaborated![/h2]
Now you can beat selected worlds and check out your latest times - or, like usual, beat the whole mode.
 

[h2]Fixes and changes[/h2]
• Visuals of the blades have been adjusted. Blue is the new white!
• Inukari is now able to release the wall-grip if you press "down".
• Now you can jump within 3 seconds if you fall down.
• Some levels have been adjusted and some positions have been altered due to the flow of the game.
• The V-sync bug problem for the "bugs" and "waterfalls" should've been fixed now.
• A bug has been fixed, if you've pressed F10 in the menu. (All eyes on [url=https://twitter.com/Raionky1]Raionky[/url])!)
 
[i]A concluding word:[/i]
I wish from all of my heart, that version 1.1 will bring you joy.
Of course I may not please all of you or be agreeing in all opinions.
I think that's okay. I just won't discuss about one topic: personal taste.
 
Just saying :3
[i][b]Kai Kieschnick
Einzelartig Games[/b][/i]

notes.title: Mini Patch
notes.content:
Hey everyone, 
I made a little fix cause of some V-Sync problems.
But u must have V-Sync activated in your graphic settings. To keep the game on smooth 60fps. Otherwise I can go over 120 and it will cause problems with the unity engine Delta.Time. 

And that will cause problems with the Bugs in the Forest or with the platforms in Hills waterfalls.

Keep going,
Kai Kieschnick
Einzelartig Games <3
